description: Ask Autonomad a question or raise a problem for this person — and get the answer IN THIS CALL. The result's `reply` is Autonomad's answer (automated, instant), using the person's own flight, hotel and experience details where relevant; show it to the person. It is saved in their Autonomad thread. Only if it cannot be resolved automatically (or needs_person is true) does it become a support ticket; then `what_happens_next` says exactly what is pending — repeat that and promise nothing more: never say a person will reply, or when. BOOKING CHANGES are part of Trip Concierge: With Trip Concierge, you can change, rebook or cancel your bookings through whichever way you prefer — Autonomad's concierge, your own autonomous agent, or an assistant like ChatGPT, Claude or Muse. With it on the trip: `action` {type: "cancel", reference} first lists what can be cancelled (nothing changes) and cancels only when called again with confirm: true; {type: "rebook" | "modify", reference} first says what would be passed on (nothing is), and passes the request (described in text) to that trip's concierge only when called again with confirm: true; its outcome appears in get_updates. Without it, the answer is concierge_required — tell the person they can add Trip Concierge in the Autonomad app or make the change themselves in My Trips. Never say something was changed unless `action` reports it. If the tool errors, the message was NOT answered — say so. Never include card numbers, passwords or one-time codes.

action.description: Optional, and only with Trip Concierge on the trip: a cancellation, or a rebook/modify request for the concierge.

component_ids.description: cancel: only these parts (from the preview). Omit for all.

confirm.description: false/omitted = preview only, nothing changes or is passed on; true = cancel, or pass the rebook/modify to the concierge, only after the person agreed.

reference.description: The booking reference the person was given (e.g. ANM-1A2B3C4D), or the trip id.

needs_person.description: true only when the person asks for a human, or the instant answer did not solve it: opens a support ticket instead of answering automatically.

text.description: The question, problem or requested change, in the person's words where possible. Up to 4000 characters.

name: message_autonomad
